data.name: Marriott Panama Hotel
data.address: Albrook Mall, Av. Roosevelt, Panama City, Panamá Province, Panama
data.description:
Next to the Albrook Mall and the Estación Albrook metro station, this contemporary hotel is 6 km from Panama Bay and 14 km from the Bridge of the Americas at the Panama Canal.
The sleek, modern rooms and suites feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, along with minifridges, coffeemakers and sitting areas. Some rooms have fitness equipment. Suites add living rooms. Room service is available 24/7.
Amenities include a fitness room and a rooftop infinity pool with city and canal views. There are 23 meeting rooms and 2 ballrooms available. With direct access to the mall, restaurants and bars are nearby.
